text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup. Grass Wonder 
discovers that her name is listed 
alongside Maruzensky's in the projected 
lineup for the Arima Kinen.

She acutely felt that the day of her 
direct showdown with the "Monster" was 
drawing near.

Right before the race. Facing El Condor 
Pasa, Grass Wonder headed into battle 
alongside her, harboring her pride as the 
"Monster the Second" in her heart.
